title: [CertiK｜低风险｜OTA-06][audit-fix] 强退事件把短暂存在的 W 余额当成实际收款（修复验收与回归）
description:
## 来源与修复范围

来源：[CertiK TSV 初审报告（原始 PDF）](https://gitlab.okg.com/web3-dex/tsv/uploads/4b71892b28b1a3f8a9851a862d66ee15/CertiK-PRE-OKX-TSV---Audit__preliminary-20261030T231203Z.pdf)，第 28,29 页，编号 **OTA-06**，原报告等级 **Low**。原报告状态为 Pending；以下状态是 2026-10-31 独立代码复核结论，不代表 CertiK 已确认关闭。

**修复目标分支：`audit/2026-10-27-6402443-fix`（audit-fix）。请本项单独提交修复/验证记录，建立对应 MR，不与其他审计项混成一个不可独立验收的变更。**

- 报告审计 commit：`85623cd73ab6248b4acec71f478f30088c4deec3`。
- audit-fix 复核 commit：`543dcd34e882eead3a9f2391540c704105fbc693`。
- main 对照 commit：`a8bfc93aa2cf40142e6511e5069d90f65b59f420`；本 Issue 的修复目标是 audit-fix。

## 双基线复核

- **audit-fix：已修复该根因**
- **main：已修复该根因**

两个基线都已把股票侧余额快照切到结算资产 U，原报告的 W/U 口径错误已修。

### 原因与实现

新增 _settlementCurrency，通过 verifiedPermissionsAdapterOf 把 W 解析为 U，Q 保持原币种。TSV 强退和发行方强退均以解析后的结算资产做前后快照。事件 token0/token1 仍是池的 W/Q 标识，股票侧 amount 则对应实际 U 的 raw units。

### 影响与利用前提

必须告诉索引方“池币种标识”和“实际到账资产”的区别，避免直接读取 W.balanceOf 判断收款。但快照仍可能受回调额外转账影响，OTA-07 没有因此修复。若接入不符合准入约束的收税/重基币种，亦不能据此保证精确净到账。

## audit-fix 处理要求与验收条件

- [ ] 保留两条强退路径通过 _settlementCurrency 把 W 映射为实际 U 后记录余额的修复，Q 保持原币种。
- [ ] 明确事件 token0/token1 是池 W/Q 标识，而股票侧到账数额为 U raw units，并同步索引/对账说明。
- [ ] 补完整回归：TSV/发行方强退、股票位于 currency0/currency1、LP 正常收款及发行方 fallback；OTA-07 单独修复，不以本项修复覆盖它。
- [ ] 在本 Issue 记录最终处理、对应 MR/完整 commit、验证命令与结果，并提供供 CertiK 复核的证据；已修复项以复核和回归补全验收，不制造无意义的重复代码改动。

### 修复建议及注意事项

建议 CertiK 按此根因标记修复；补充两种强退路径及股票在 currency0/currency1 两种排序的到账事件回归测试。继续单独跟踪 OTA-07，不要把两个事件问题合并关闭。

- main：[ `src/v1/libraries/TSVLPManagerLib.sol:126` ](https://gitlab.okg.com/web3-dex/tsv/-/blob/a8bfc93aa2cf40142e6511e5069d90f65b59f420/src/v1/libraries/TSVLPManagerLib.sol#L126)；`Currency settlement0 = _settlementCurrency(p.factory, poolKey.currency0);`
- audit-fix：[ `src/v1/libraries/TSVLPManagerLib.sol:237` ](https://gitlab.okg.com/web3-dex/tsv/-/blob/543dcd34e882eead3a9f2391540c704105fbc693/src/v1/libraries/TSVLPManagerLib.sol#L237)；`function _settlementCurrency(IPermissionsAdapterFactory factory, Currency currency)`

## 已有验证与边界

静态确认两条强退路径在两基线均调用新的结算资产解析逻辑；本次未执行完整 LP 强退事件动态 PoC。

本次为报告逐项复核，未发送生产交易；mock 边界测试不代表完整端到端攻击或现网资产/角色配置已经确认。

相关既有审计记录：#11。本单保留 CertiK 原始编号与单独验收要求。

OTA-06   OKX TSV - AUDIT


OTA-06            Forced Exit Events Measure Transient Wrapper Balances
                  Instead Of Underlying




 Category             Severity      Location                                                                        Status


 Coding Issue             Low       vendor/permissionedPools/PermissionsAdapter.sol: 132~133                           Pending


  Description


 TSVLPManagerV1.unwindPositionByTsv         and   unwindPosition     allow authorized TSV and issuer operators, respectively, to
burn an LP position and deliver its principal and accrued fees. Their aggregate     TsvPositionUnwound      and

 IssuerPositionUnwound      events report the amounts received by the LP and issuer for each pool currency so that off-chain
systems can reconcile the forced exit.

Both paths derive these event amounts from recipient balance changes in the PoolKey currencies. For example, the TSV
path snapshots both PoolKey currency balances before the burn and emits their post-burn differences, including the W
balance for the permissioned stock leg:


  // TSVLPManagerLib.unwindPositionByTsv(...) —
  src/v1/libraries/TSVLPManagerLib.sol:152-162
          emit TsvPositionUnwound(
              tokenId,
              lp,
              issuer,
              Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency0),
              Currency.unwrap(poolKey.currency1),
              poolKey.currency0.balanceOf(lp) - lpBalance0Before,
              0,
              poolKey.currency1.balanceOf(lp) - lpBalance1Before,
              0
          );


The issuer path applies the same accounting through       _recipientBalances     , reading W balances for both the LP and issuer
before and after delivery. This measurement is invalid for a permissioned stock leg because W is only transiently transferred
to the recipient. When the PoolManager sends W,       PermissionsAdapter._update        immediately burns the recipient's W and
transfers the same amount of underlying U:

[PDF page 29]
OTA-06    OKX TSV - AUDIT





  // PermissionsAdapter._update(address,address,uint256) —
  src/v1/vendor/permissionedPools/PermissionsAdapter.sol:132-141
          super._update(from, to, amount);
          _unwrap(to, amount);
          // the pool manager must always be the only holder of the permissions
  adapter
          assert(balanceOf(POOL_MANAGER) == totalSupply());
      }


      function _unwrap(address account, uint256 amount) internal {
          _burn(account, amount);
          SafeERC20(address(PERMISSIONED_TOKEN)).safeTransfer(account, amount);
      }


For every successful forced exit with a positive W amount, the recipient receives U while its W balance returns to its pre-
delivery value. The corresponding stock amount in        TsvPositionUnwound        or IssuerPositionUnwound         is therefore recorded
as zero. On issuer exits, this aggregate event can contradict the nonzero amount in           CurrencyUnwound      and the underlying U
transfer; the TSV path provides no equivalent per-leg unwind event. Event-based accounting, compliance reports, forced-exit
alerts, and historical position reconstruction consequently omit the delivered stock proceeds and assign incomplete exit
amounts to the LP or issuer.


  Recommendation

Account for the asset that the recipient actually receives. Resolve each verified W to its underlying U before taking recipient
balance snapshots, and use U balance changes for permissioned legs while continuing to use Q balances for quote legs.
Prefer propagating the known burn or delivery amount and actual recipient from the settlement path into the aggregate event:

 unwindPosition      can use its existing  amount0     and  amount1    values together with the delivery result, while

 unwindPositionByTsv       should capture the realized burn amounts or route delivery through the same accounting helper.
Define whether the event's token fields identify W or the delivered U, and apply that convention consistently to aggregate and
per-leg events.
